caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with ornate decorative features. The chest is rectangular and supported by four sturdy, straight legs. Its main body consists of an upper section with three door panels, each adorned with intricate carved designs and flanked by dark vertical spindle-like columns. The central door panel is decorated with swirling patterns and leaf motifs, while the two outer panels feature symmetrical floral designs. Below these are two wide drawers, each with dark, oval-shaped handles and bordered with angular trim, echoing the chest's overall geometric structure. The side panel of the chest is also framed and contains a single dark metal handle. The wood tones throughout range from light to medium brown, with contrasting black or very dark brown accents highlighting the columns, handles, and some borders. The entire image is set against a plain, light-colored background and enclosed within a simple rectangular border. The drawing utilizes careful shading and perspective to give the chest a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
